subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): record channel/conversation origin in capture metadata and recall logs

question: Should this issue remain separate for operator audit logging, or should its unique recall-log acceptance criterion be consolidated into the structured provenance work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/59130?
rationale: The technical seam is available, but maintainers must select one persisted origin contract, privacy model, and canonical tracker before implementation.

options.title: Consolidate provenance work
options.body: Use the older provenance issue as canonical and preserve this issue's operator-audit and recall-event logging requirements there.

options.title: Keep separate audit tracking
options.body: Retain this issue for logging and operational audit workflows while requiring both items to share one approved persisted provenance schema.

recommendation.title: Consolidate provenance work
recommendation.body: Use the older provenance issue as canonical and preserve this issue's operator-audit and recall-event logging requirements there.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the broadest sustained ownership across memory-lancedb implementation, tests, and product-facing refactors.
